descriptionHtml:
Cooler Master Hyper 212 Spectrum V3 ARGB CPU Air Cooler (4 Direct Contact Heat Pipes / 120mm Spectrum ARGB PWM Fan / Silver Aluminum Fins / Intel LGA 1851 1700 & AMD AM5 AM4 Ready / RR-S4NA-17PA-R1 / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Keep your high-performance processor running cool and quiet with the iconic Cooler Master Hyper 212 Spectrum V3 CPU Air Cooler, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Upgraded for modern high-density desktop architectures, this tower cooler features 4 direct-contact copper heat pipes arrayed through nickel-plated aluminum cooling fins for rapid heat dissipation. It comes equipped with a high-airflow 120mm Spectrum Addressable RGB (ARGB) PWM fan operating between 650 to 1750 RPM while producing maximum airflow up to 71.93 CFM at quiet acoustics of just 27.2 dBA. Designed for universal socket hardware installation, it offers out-of-the-box native mounting support for latest Intel LGA 1851 / 1700 and AMD AM5 / AM4 platforms.
